question: How should the six limbs be ritually placed on the body?
premises: A preparation involving six long vowels is prescribed.
The six limbs are the objects of placement.
The body is specified as the location.
inference: Having prepared with the six long vowels, one should place the six limbs on the body.
plain_english: Having made it with the six long vowels, one should place the six limbs on the body.
